verdicts.reason: A: the flavour names are reversed and split from their descriptors, which sit in a separate list in yet another order. The cans come in two sizes (one large on the left, two tiny bottom-right), and the logo floats off on its own at the right. The CTA is at least big and readable. B has the same scrambled centre text stack, and its 'Build Your Pack' CTA has shrunk to an unreadable pill. The two cans beside it are tiny stubs, and one large can is jammed against the right edge, so the action is buried.

A has an illegible miniature CTA, tiny can stubs, a cramped centred text clump with names separated from their descriptors, and a lone large can on the right edge. B gives the headline and CTA real presence, but the headline almost touches the left edge. The cans come in three different sizes and are scattered on the right, the CTA overlaps the lower can area, and the descriptor list is still scrambled and very small.

A uses a sensible centred axis with a readable CTA, but the text stack is crammed with tiny descriptors detached from their flavour names. The logo is shrunk to near-invisibility, and the three cans are inconsistent sizes (large left, medium and tiny right). B is the same broken layout as before: an unreadable mini CTA, tiny can stubs, one can pushed to the right edge, and a scrambled text clump.
